name: Google Drive
description: Keeps encrypted copies of your COGNIX[WS] backups in your Google Drive, in a "COGNIX[WS] backups" folder. COGNIX[WS] encrypts everything before it leaves this computer, and it can see only the files it created in your Drive.

settings.label: Google sign-in
settings.description: Kept by the extension when you sign in on its page. Removing it signs COGNIX[WS] out of Google Drive.
